command:
START=$(date +%s); python3 -u scripts/heartbeat_loop.py --dir demo-run --run-id demo --start "$START" --deadline $((START+8)) --interval 2 --tz-offset 8; python3 -c "
import json
print(\"seq  kind    time(+08)  gap\")
for line in open(\"demo-run/heartbeats.jsonl\"):
    h=json.loads(line)
    print(f\"{h[\"seq\"]:<4} {h[\"kind\"]:<7} {h[\"timestamp\"][11:19]}    {h[\"gap\"]:.3f}s\")
"

environment.isolation: disposable copy; not an OS sandbox
